summary: A completed-green next-campaign recommendation packet is not complete if only structured report helpers expose the full strategy. Stop decisions and plain operator-facing CLI output must carry enough of the same packet to preserve traceability and prevent hidden continuation ambiguity.
lesson: When adding a repo-native advisory packet, verify surface parity across decide-next stop decisions, status --operator-read, campaign-report, and wakeup. JSON may carry the full evidence and draft declaration, but plain output must still show fresh approval, may_open_scope=false, and the top recommendation.
impact: Prevents a green loop from appearing complete in structured paths while the operator-facing/default path hides the next-campaign recommendation or approval boundary.
recommended_action: Add surface-parity assertions whenever autonomous-auto introduces a new operator packet or campaign strategy surface.
